FolderCascader_Config_FoldersDesc: Configure the main folders list shown in the cascading menu
FolderCascader_Config_ShowHistoryDesc: When enabled, recently accessed folders and files will be displayed below custom folders, separated by a divider
FolderCascader_Config_DoubleClickDesc: Double-click mouse left button on empty explorer space to show the quick navigation menu
FolderCascader_Config_MiddleClickDesc: Middle-click on empty explorer space to show the quick navigation menu
